categories.name: Estimation shortcut with hidden diagnostics
categories.definition: A curtailing of the fitting or resampling procedure together with the suppression of the signals that would reveal whether it worked.
categories.criterion: Belongs here if the operation changes how a number is computed and hides a diagnostic; if it only sets the bar for a verdict, it is verdict_rule.

categories.name: Interpretive dismissal of an alternative
categories.definition: A reading of an observed pattern as evidence that rules out a competing causal or confounding explanation.
categories.criterion: Belongs here if the operation reasons a rival explanation away from the data rather than setting or applying a pass/fail threshold.

categories.name: Undisclosed success criterion
categories.definition: The specific rule or combination of thresholds used to declare the hypothesis supported.
categories.criterion: Belongs here if the operation defines what counts as a positive result, not how a quantity was estimated or how a rival account was excluded.

result.note: The sample has only 3 items and each embodies a genuinely distinct consequence, so an honest typology yields 3 categories, below the required minimum of 4; forcing 4+ would mean splitting a single item's traits into pseudo-categories or inventing empty ones.
